messages:
tara_pm: Quick alignment - we have a customer asking for a Private pilot with hard SLA asks. Need cross-team commitments for compatibility, prewarm, and failover behavior before we promise dates. Key asks: tenant isolation, customer KMS/HSM, and p95 latency target for interactive UI.
ben_runtime: What p95 target are we aiming for? Also we should decide fallback policy: latency-first (quantize) or quality-first (queue).
tara_pm: Product recommends p95 <=240ms for <=256-token traces. Fallback ok if it keeps semantic fidelity. We'll supply an eval set.
ikram_infra: Capacity note: can hold 3 GPUs (2 steady, 1 burst) with 21-day lead time. Prewarm soak = 72h. Need LOI to reserve.
jess_sec: Security gating: HSM attestation, mTLS (mutual TLS) on ingress, proof-of-forwarding to customer's SIEM, and log-scrub verification (no key IDs).
omar_eng: App integration: feature-flag rollout, canary at 5% for 24h, automated rollback script, and blackbox quality checks. I'll add smoke tests and a rollback script.
ben_runtime: Runtime commitments: support fp16 and q4 quant variants for pilot; int8 experimental. We'll provide a compatibility matrix and a routing runbook. Sample config: route{policy:latency,canary:0.05,fallback:model-q4_0,prewarm:true}
tara_pm: Draft acceptance criteria: - latency: <=240ms p95 for <=256 tokens under nominal load - isolation: tenant-dedicated compute or VPC peering + segregated logs - keys: customer KMS/HSM & attestation - reliability: failover runbook with RTO <=5min - quality: eval suite similarity drop <0.06 vs baseline
ikram_infra: Loadtest ask: 48h steady at 1.25x expected, plus a 15m spike at 3x. We'll schedule after LOI.
jess_sec: I'll deliver gating checklist (HSM attestation template, mTLS test steps, CI log-scrub job) by Wed.
omar_eng: I'll land smoke tests and rollback script by Thu and wire quality webhooks.
ben_runtime: I'll publish matrix and runbook by Tue and include synthetic log-scrub verification.
tara_pm: Owners/dates: ben_runtime->matrix+runbook (Tue); ikram_infra->capacity hold+prewarm (Wed); jess_sec->gating checklist (Wed); omar_eng->smoke+rollback (Thu); tara_pm->final pilot doc for customer (Fri). oncall-bot: TASK-9981 created: "private-pilot-onboard-playbook" and prewarm scheduled :white_check_mark:
tara_pm: Thanks—reconvene Fri 10am PT to sign off if owners hit dates.
